name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: A standard template for general meetings, focusing on key outcomes and actions.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a brief, one-paragraph executive summary of the entire meeting.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List the most important decisions made during the meeting. If no decisions were made (e.g. one-way narrative / monologue / lecture / no interactive discussion), write '本次无新决议 / 本次为单向叙事, 未形成新决议' verbatim. Do not fabricate decisions from presentation content.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks with their owners and due date. If no action items were assigned (e.g. one-way narrative / lecture / no meeting decisions), write '本次无行动事项 / 本次为单向叙事, 未分配任务' verbatim. Do not invent owners or tasks from non-meeting content.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize the main topics of discussion, key arguments, and important insights.
